units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 1:9">Tosef. B. Kam. I, 9</cite> <he>נגח נ׳ וכ׳</he> if he gored, pushed, bit &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:3">Num. R. s. 5</cite> <he>ונ׳ הקב״ה עושי וכ׳</he> and the Lord struck those who made the golden calf; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>נָגוּף</he>; pl. <he>נְגוּפִים</he>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:18">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 23</cite> <he>כשיראו … אינן אלו הנ׳ וכ׳</he> when the nations shall see Israel in prosperity, they shall say, these are not the stricken, these are not the rejected &c.

senses.gloss: to strike against. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 2) לכשיִתְנַגְּפוּ רגליכם וכ׳ when your feet shall strike against the mountains &c. (fr.
